prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Baytown, Texas. Injury: shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1252; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was making a left turn at an intersection in Baytown, Texas, when another vehicle struck the side of my car. I had the green light and was waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic when the impact came from the driver's side. The force threw me against the door and I felt a sharp pain in my right shoulder right away. I have given the same account of what happened to the other driver, to the responding officer, and to my own insurer, and I have not changed any detail. I am the named driver on this policy, and I am filing this claim for the damage to my vehicle and for the medical treatment my shoulder injury has required since the collision.
